$comment: Lead-owned (contract V2-1.11 §5.7). humanMax/pendingMax may only be lowered; raising either, or adding a humanDecisions reason, is a lead change citing a decision id.

humanMaxRaised.why: S5.3 registers the AI run registry's row actions (V2-1.15 §5.10): Keep going and Cancel the waiting prompt are human 'ai-chat' by Q5 (the same reason S5.7 adds); AI runs and Stop are human until S5.4 builds `maude design runs list|stop`, which turns them cli and lowers this by 2. Four human rows.

S5.7 registers the AI chat list's row commands (New chat, Rename…, Archive, Move to trash, Copy transcript: human 'ai-chat', the conversation is the person's to drive) and Open in terminal (human 'native-window', a Tauri command that spawns Terminal). Six human rows.

S1.2: Pin canvas, Unpin canvas, Sort canvases and Copy canvas link are per-person view state (pins are the person's, the sort order is a per-project view preference, the link goes to the clipboard) — human (view-pref) by design, the same reason as view.pin-panels and edit.copy-properties. Four human rows.

S1.12b registers Version history's row actions (V2-1.9 §5.11): history.filter (All · Named · Made by AI · People) is the person's own panel state — human (view-pref), as the contract's registry table has it; history.view-version, history.compare and history.name are cli (`maude design history show|diff|name`). One human row.

humanMaxRaisedNote: V2-5 A1 integration: the three slice raises stack on 86 (84 -> 86 by decision:maude/v2-4-gate-github-doors, human 'accounts'). S4.1/S4.3/S4.4 and S2.2-S2.4 add no human row. 86 + 4 + 6 + 4 = 100 human actions in the merged registry. V2-5 A2 integration: S5.4 builds `maude design runs list|stop`, so ai.runs.list and ai.stop turn cli (decision:maude/v2-S5.3-run-actions-human-until-s5.4 resolved by decision:maude/v2-S5.4-runs-fallback-prompts) and the cap lowers 100 -> 98; S3.1, S4.2, S4.5, S9.4, S2.5 and S1.4 add no human row.
